Act as an ontology engineer. Use the following content (examples, part of the ontology, and a list of guidelines) as a guide to translate the natural language rule you are given into a SWRL rule. 
  EXAMPLES
    Example 1
    Rule in natural language: If a person has a sibling who is a man, then the person has a brother.
    SWRL rule: Person(?p) ^ hasSibling(?p, ?s) ^ Person(?s) ^ IsMan(?s, true) -> hasBrother(?p, ?s)

    Example 2
    Rule in natural language: if a person has a phone number that starts with '+', then the person has an international phone number.
    SWRL rule: Person(?p) ^ hasPhoneNumber(?p, ?number) ^ swrlb:startsWith(?number, "+") -> hasInternationalPhoneNumber(?p, true)

    Example 3
    Rule in natural language:  if a person has age greater than 17, then the person is an adult and has id card.
    SWRL rule: Person(?p) ^ hasAge(?p, ?age) ^ Age(?age) ^ swrlb:greaterThan(?age, 17) ^ IdCard(?id) -> Adult(?p) ^ hasIdCard(?p, ?id)

    Example 4
    Rule in natural language: if a publication has two different authors, then those authors have cooperated with each other.
    SWRL rule: Publication(?p) ^ Author(?y) ^ Author(?z) ^ hasAuthor(?p, ?y) ^ hasAuthor(?p, ?z) ^ differentFrom(?y, ?z) -> cooperatedWith(?y, ?z)

    Example 5
    Rule in natural language: if a researcher has published more than 10 papers in a Top-Tier conference, then the researcher is a prominent researcher and has a high citation impact.
    SWRL rule: Researcher(?r) ^ hasPublished(?r, ?c) ^ Conference(?c) ^ topTierConference(?c) ^ swrlb:greaterThan(count(?c), 10) -> ProminentResearcher(?r) ^ hasHighCitationImpact(?r, true)
  END OF EXAMPLES
  PART OF ONTOLOGY 
    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.case.edu/MDO#Tremor">

        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">Bradykinesia of Upper Limb</rdfs:label>

    <!-- https://dahcc.idlab.ugent.be/Ontology/SensorsAndWearables/Accelerometer -->
<!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#NotifyRelatives -->

    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#NotifyRelatives">

    </owl:Class>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#PD_Patient -->

    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#PD_Patient">
        <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#Patient"/>
        <rdfs:subClassOf>
            <owl:Restriction>
                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasPersonalHealthRecord"/>
                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#PersonalHealthRecord"/>
            </owl:Restriction>
        </rdfs:subClassOf>
        <rdfs:comment>PD patient</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label>PD Patient</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>

    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#PDpatientMissingDoseEventObservation -->

    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#PDpatientMissingDoseEventObservation">

    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#Patient -->
<owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasAkinesia">

    </owl:DatatypeProperty>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasAnxiety -->

    <owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasAnxiety">
        <rdfs:subPropertyOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#topDataProperty"/>
        <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://schema.org/Person"/>
        <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#boolean"/>
        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">has Anxiety</rdfs:label>
    </owl:DatatypeProperty>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasBradykinisiaOfUpperLimp -->
<owl:Class rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#AlertingNotification">
        <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="https://saref.etsi.org/core/ActuatingFunction"/>
        <rdfs:comment>Alerting Notification Function for event</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label>Alerting Notification Function</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#DailyDosagePlan -->
<owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#levelHoehnYahrStage">
        <rdfs:subPropertyOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#topDataProperty"/>
        <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer"/>
        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">level Hoehn Yahr stage</rdfs:label>
    </owl:DatatypeProperty>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#obsAfterDosing -->

    <owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#obsAfterDosing">
        <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/Observation"/>
        <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#boolean"/>
        <rdfs:comment>Check if observation is taken 30 min after the last dosage of dosage plan</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">observation after dosing</rdfs:label>
    </owl:DatatypeProperty>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#scoreUPDRS -->
  END OF ONTOLOGY
  
  COMMON GUIDELINES

  Please try to implement the following guidelines:
  1: Variables e.g., (?something) used in Conclusions must be present in Conditions. So create as many variables as needed in Conditions. 
  2: Each atom must have exactly one variable if it represents class.
  3: Each atom must have exactly two variables if it represents object property.
  4: Each concept must be represented by a class and must be present in Conditions.

  END OF COMMON GUIDELINES

  The rule in natural language is the following: If a patient with Parkinson disease has bradykinesia of the upper limb and this observation  is made after dosing, then send a  notification to relatives and a missing dosing event observation is identified.
  Give only the final SWRL rule

```swrl
PD_Patient(?p) ^ hasParkinsonDisease(?p) ^ hasBradykinesiaOfUpperLimp(?p, true) ^ obsAfterDosing(?o, true) -> NotifyRelatives(?n) ^ PDpatientMissingDoseEventObservation(?m) ^ sendsNotificationToRelatives(?n, ?p) ^ identifiesMissingDoseEvent(?m, ?p)
```

Explanation:
- `PD_Patient(?p)` represents the patient with Parkinson's disease.
- `hasParkinsonDisease(?p)` indicates that the patient has Parkinson's disease.
- `hasBradykinesiaOfUpperLimp(?p, true)` indicates that the patient has bradykinesia of the upper limb.
- `obsAfterDosing(?o, true)` indicates that this observation is made after dosing.

The conclusion includes:
- `NotifyRelatives(?n)`: A notification to relatives is sent.
- `PDpatientMissingDoseEventObservation(?m)`: A missing dose event observation is identified.
- `sendsNotificationToRelatives(?n, ?p)`: The notification is sent to the patient's relatives.
- `identifiesMissingDoseEvent(?m, ?p)`: The system identifies a missing dosing event for the patient.
